visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a plaid flannel shirt, sits in front of a silver laptop on a light wooden table. She has a concerned, squinting facial expression as she peers closely at the screen. The background shows a neutral-toned sofa and framed artwork on a white wall. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the laptop screen, showing a dark-mode text editor with a list of restaurant names and hours. The text is extremely zoomed in. The woman's hands are visible on the silver keyboard, typing. (3) A young man with a short haircut and a striped shirt is standing in a living room, looking at a computer monitor on a standing desk. The background includes a large television and a shelf. (4) Screen capture of a website registration form showing a dropdown menu for the birth year. The cursor scrolls rapidly down past the year 2020, through the 2010s and 2000s, landing deep in the 1990s. (5) The man turns to face the camera, laughing with a wide, amused expression. He then turns back to the laptop with a slight smile, his hand on the mouse. (6) The man and the woman are sitting on the floor of a brightly lit living room, looking at a large television screen displaying a K-pop music video with young idols performing. The woman points at the screen. (7) The woman holds her smartphone with a shocked expression, her mouth open and eyes wide behind her glasses. She is looking at her screen. (8) On the television, numerical age markers (20, 19, 17, 16) appear over the heads of the dancing idols. The woman and man react with disbelief, gesturing towards the screen. (9) The man puts both hands on the sides of his head in a gesture of despair or shock while looking at the woman, who continues to talk animatedly. (10) The man and woman sit together on a park bench outdoors. They are talking to someone off-camera. The background shows green trees and a sunlit park path. (11) They both react with exaggerated shock, lean back, and look at each other as large question marks and exclamation points appear as graphic overlays on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, clear 'ding' notification sound plays. A female voice speaks with a fast, slightly strained conversational tone, complaining about text size. A male voice interjects loudly with '太大了!' in a high-arousal, comical tone. Background music is a light, synth-heavy upbeat comedy track. (2) A second sharp 'ding' triggers. The male voice laughs heartily with a wide pitch contour, saying '屁啦'. He continues speaking with a friendly, relaxed tone about scrolling through years on a screen. The music beat is steady and prominent. (3) A 'ding' sound starts a new segment. The male and female voices overlap in rapid, excited conversation. A loud, sharp 'slap' or 'hit' SFX occurs as numbers are mentioned. The female voice reaches a high arousal level as she expresses shock. (4) A final 'ding'. The BGM shifts slightly as outdoor ambient nature sounds are faint. The voices start calm, then a dramatic cartoon-style 'shocker' synth chord plays. Both voices rise sharply in volume and pitch, shouting in realization about the year 2000.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Example 1 -> Example 2 -> Example 3 -> Example 4 -> Climax/Realization
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous and relatable compilation of everyday moments that make millennials or older Gen Z realize they are aging. It uses four specific scenarios: needing larger text on screens, scrolling far for birth years, idols being significantly younger, and the fact that people born in 2000 are already in their mid-20s.
